# Import & Data Cleaning

```{r import}
df.raw <- read.csv('Life Expectancy Data.csv')
df.raw <- na.omit(df.raw)
df <- df.raw
```

# Categorical variables

Only `Country` and `Status` are categorical.

```{r categorical-country}
## countries
country_freq_table <- table(df$Country)
plot(country_freq_table)
```

```{r categorical-status}
## status
status_freq_table <- table(df$Status)
plot(status_freq_table)
```

# Numerical variables

```{r numeric-cols}
(df.numeric <- df[, sapply(df, is.numeric)])
```

```{r numeric-scatterplots}
lapply(names(df.numeric), function(column_name) {
  plot(numeric.cols$Life.expectancy~numeric.cols[[column_name]],
       xlab = column_name,
       ylab = "Life Expectancy")
})
```
 `thinness.5.9.years`, `thinness.1.19.years`, `population`, `GDP`, `HIV.AIDS`, `under.five.deaths`, `Measles`, `percentage.expenditure`, `infant.deaths`, are chosen for log transform.

```{r log-transform-elgibility}
lapply(names(numeric.cols), function(column_name) {
  par(mfrow=c(1,2))
  fit <- lm(df$Life.expectancy ~ df[[column_name]])
  plot(fit, which=1, main=column_name)
  plot(fit, which=3)
})
```
```{r}
chosen.col <- "Adult.Mortality"
plot(df$Life.expectancy ~ df[[chosen.col]])
plot(df$Life.expectancy ~ log1p(df[[chosen.col]]))
```
